responsibility: Implements the rs6000 RTL optimization pass that removes unnecessary VSX doubleword-swap instructions on little-endian Power8-era vector code. The pass analyzes load/compute/store webs with dataflow and union-find machinery, identifies computations whose element-order semantics are preserved without xxswapdi, rewrites eligible swaps into copies or adjusts special swappable operations, and performs follow-up passes for aligned memory accesses and vector constants, reducing redundant endian-fixup code before later RTL cleanup.
